description: This function captures the leading digit of a course number and turns it into a hundred-level value.

steps.description: parse_course_level accepts an optional string and promises an optional integer result.
Empty values return None before matching. The pattern accepts department letters, an optional hyphen, and captures only the first course-number digit.

steps.answer: The captured first digit is 2, so the function returns 200.
steps.question: What level does MATH210-NAME produce?

steps.description: The loop tests names with and without a hyphen, a three-digit course number, invalid text, an empty string, and None.
For a matching course name, group(1) supplies the digit used to compute its level.

title: Extract a course level
